about_the_game:
Hellaven - This is a comedy visual novel about an angel imprisoned for life in a heavenly prison many years ago for selling drugs, but at one point his life changes and he is forced to go on an adventure to understand his past

Story

70 years ago, under certain circumstances, a white-haired angel appears in a heavenly prison, but in one day everything changes, and a girl comes to him with an offer of cooperation that is impossible to win, because it helps him free himself from life imprisonment and start a new life... The main thing is not to make past mistakes again, or to make sure that no one knows about it... And you will also have to see old acquaintances and meet many new friends in the human world.

Peculiarities

Duration: 3-4 hours

Full voice acting of the novel (so far only in Russian)

Full video scenes between transitions from locations

Several secret characters

Lots of cute, funny and spicy moments

Colorful, scenic art

Black humor

Dynamic action scenes with different outcome

Elements of Fanservice

Partial animation of sprites and background

content_descriptors.notes: This visual novel contains suggestive scenes, drug use, partial nudity and fan service. There are also a few scenes of a non-sexual nature that some readers may find disturbing or unsettling. Flashing animation may trigger photosensitive epilepsy.
